purpose: Teach: フェルナンド/クルス/ヴェルディ/サダム/リヨン/スコープ/アグリ/ドーン

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスペインのフェルナンド王のドキュメンタリー観てらっしゃるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's watching a documentary about King Ferdinand of Spain right now.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact observation. Gentle pace. Slight lift at the end, inviting Sho's attention without demanding it. The voice of someone noticing what her son might find interesting.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとペネロペ・クルスのインタビュー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched an interview with Penélope Cruz with Dad!
lines.style: Bright, immediate excitement. Quick tempo, words tumbling forward. The pride of sharing something he did with his father. A small, genuine laugh underneath the eagerness.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがヴェルディの「椿姫」のCDを聴かれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's listening to Verdi's La Traviata on CD at the moment.
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly musical in cadence. Measured pace. Softly curious — noticing the breadth of her husband's interests, inviting Sho to notice it too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとサダム政権のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched a documentary about Saddam's regime with Dad!
lines.style: Same brightness as before, but a beat of uncertainty underneath — testing whether this is the kind of thing to tell Mom. Still eager, but slightly smaller.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがリヨン市の歴史本を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's reading a history book about the city of Lyon right now.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation in her voice. Steady, even pace. The gentle amusement of a wife recognizing her husband's wandering curiosities. No judgment, just noticing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと望遠スコープで月を観たよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I looked at the moon through a telescope together!
lines.style: Pure, uncomplicated joy. Voice opens up. Slower, savoring each word. The wonder of something magical shared. Ends with warmth, not rushing to the next thing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがアグリ事業の本を読まれてるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father's reading a book about agricultural business at the moment.
lines.style: Affectionate weariness beneath the gentle report. Steady voice. The patient amusement of someone who has stopped trying to predict what will fascinate her husband next.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと「ドーン・オブ・ザ・デッド」のリメイク観たよ
lines.en: Mom, I watched the Dawn of the Dead remake with Dad!
lines.style: Bright energy, but with a hint of testing — checking her reaction. Quick delivery. The last word lands with a small, satisfied emphasis, like he's delivered the punchline to see if she'll smile.
